name: Negative Binomial Regression
when_to_use: Count dependent variable with overdispersion (variance greater than the mean), when Poisson does not fit.

expected_input.question: How to model counts with overdispersion?

plain_explanation.purpose: Predicts counts like Poisson, but tolerates very 'spread out' data (many zeros and a few huge values).
plain_explanation.when_to_use_plain: When counts vary far more than normal, and Poisson becomes too optimistic.
plain_explanation.data_needed: A column of integer counts and factor columns.
plain_explanation.example: Predict how many documents each legislator issues per month, when a few issue almost everything.
plain_explanation.diagram: Poisson: narrow bars | Negative binomial: bars with a long right tail
